minutes.headline: Select Board heard Flat Hill drainage options, set a site walk, and backed filing the MBTA zoning form.
minutes.summary: The board received the FY22 second quarter financial report, heard an engineer explain why drainage fixes on Flat Hill are limited, and took long public input before scheduling a site walk. It heard the land use director on the state MBTA Communities zoning mandate and agreed to submit the compliance form while studying impacts. It also ratified two clerk appointments and approved minutes.

what_happened.line: The board agreed to complete and submit the state MBTA Communities compliance form by May and to seek free technical assistance.
After long public input on Flat Hill drainage, the board set a Saturday site walk at Cortland Circle; the engineer will revise the proposal afterward.
The board will write the condo association about retention basin maintenance.
The finance director reported the second quarter FY22 revenues and expenditures, and agreed to add a line-item variance summary page.
The board ratified two clerk appointments, and tabled the Conrad's hearing item to the next meeting.

why_it_matters: Flat Hill and Cortland Circle residents with water in their yards and basements may see a drainage design funded through the capital plan, and possibly a special town meeting article.
Non-compliance with the MBTA zoning rule would bar the town from three state grant programs, so the zoning study affects what outside money the town can seek.
watch_next: The Saturday site walk and the engineer's revised drainage proposal, plus whether a drainage study needs a special town meeting article.
The MBTA Communities form due by May, and next week's budget, capital plan and warrant article discussion.
